metadata.title: De-notified Tribes - बदनाम बस्तियाँ | XAXA Report episode - 2 | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Prof. Virginius Xaxa is a renowned sociologist, who with other members of his committee submitted a report on Tribals in 2014. This committee was also addressed as the Tribal committee of 2014. It is a comprehensive report which covers various aspects related to Adivasis. There are various aspects which had been overlooked and one among them was the case of De-notified tribes. These tribes were the one who were historically mistreated because of some administrative misconceptions, where they were declared as the criminal tribes because of their nomadic nature. Their livelihood was affected and they were confined to one place, and their children taken away in different "reform camps". What happened to them after India's Independence was again an issue to dive in. This video covers all these aspects.
